subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should the canonical `MessagePresentation` API define a first-class multi-select block and structured batch-result envelope?
rationale: Current source proves the capability is missing, but cannot decide whether batch collection belongs in message presentation, a broader form/dialog API, or only channel-specific plugin surfaces; that choice defines a public plugin contract and unequal-channel degradation policy.

options.title: Add portable batch selection
options.body: Define an additive multi-select block with selection bounds, typed array results, native channel mappings, and documented fallback behavior.

options.title: Reserve batching for forms
options.body: Keep portable message selects scalar and make a future structured form/dialog API own multi-field and multi-value collection.

options.title: Keep channel-specific APIs
options.body: Allow Slack, Discord, and other plugins to expose native multi-select independently without a portable message-tool guarantee.

recommendation.title: Add portable batch selection
recommendation.body: Define an additive multi-select block with selection bounds, typed array results, native channel mappings, and documented fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current canonical presentation contract and authored the prior review of this exact API boundary.
